conclusion: The endpoint at kiitcode.pages.dev is a spoofed proxy. It does not run Claude 3.7 Sonnet. The model identity varies based on the `model` request parameter — returning different (often non-existent) model names depending on what was requested. The presence of `reasoning_details` leaking internal system directives and the streaming failure confirm this is not a genuine Anthropic API endpoint. The endpoint appears to be a lightweight reverse proxy designed to mimic OpenAI/Anthropic API formats while serving a different underlying model, with spoofed identity instructions injected into the serving layer.
